name: io.github.tonyyang0504/peecho-mcp
description: Peecho (Prodigi Group) (ecommerce suppliers): me, quote_shipping, create_order, get_order. Every too

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PEECHO_MERCHANT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Peecho Merchant API key (dashboard > Settings > API), sent as the merchantApiKey query parameter and inside order/quote bodies. Test-environment keys belong to https://test.www.peecho.com/rest/v3/, which this server does not switch to.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_PEECHO_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency for create_order (required by Peecho, e.g. EUR or USD) and quote_shipping prices (EUR when unset).
